Subject is ONLY one open retail shelf, never a street, house, storefront, landscape, or room. Preserve the silhouette, proportions, anchor and isometric direction of reference 2. Exactly four sales shelves plus base, slim upright/backboard; no roof/canopy. Fill the four green bands with compact coherent rows of Japanese convenience-store ambient products, fronts facing the E/+X customer side. Goods sit on shelves and integrate with the fixture, never floating cards, never thick cuboid boxes. Match reference 1's hand-painted game sprite quality. Transparent background and >=12% margin on each edge. No text, captions, extra objects, scenery, or white flecks. Do not change camera or shelf geometry.
